Room search now combines adjacent results when their timelines share a boundary event. The merged tile skips the duplicate event, highlights each direct match, and links matched messages to their own event IDs. A gap starts a new tile.

The focused tests pass (9 tests), and the TypeScript check and targeted ESLint check pass.
